items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I've done my vaudeville now -- I mean my show and vaudeville in New York... she would always sing something, Lili Walker would.

ctx.x: Yeah. She couldn't -- and then she didn't do too bad at that. She sang -- she would sing a song, always, Lili Walker. And let me see now, what else? So, I've done my vaudeville now -- I mean my show and vaudeville in New York, haven't I?
Yeah, I was just wondering -- I wanted to sidestep a minute about New York, and talk about sort of what life was like in New York at that time for blacks, entertainers, you know.
